title: Spectral convergence associated with Weil's quadratic form
summary: Assuming the Riemann hypothesis, we study a distinguished self-adjoint extension of the differentiation operator on a Hilbert space defined by the Weil quadratic form localized to a finite interval. The local quadratic form is determined by data from finitely many places, without requiring the zeros of the Riemann zeta function as input. We prove that the positive eigenvalues of this extension converge to the distinct positive ordinates of the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function as the interval expands.
